bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to cemeteries; requiring public cemeteries to allow individuals to be buried in accordance with their recognized religion; requiring public cemeteries to allow green burials; amending Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 306.991, subdivisions 2, 6; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 306.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[+[306.98] BURIAL; RITES OF RECOGNIZED RELIGION. +]

[+(a) For purposes of this section, "green burial" has the meaning given in section 149A.02, subdivision 42. +]

[+(b) A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter must permit an individual to be buried in accordance with the rites of the individual's recognized religion, including but not limited to permitting an individual to be buried by green burial, if the burial is performed in compliance with chapter 149A and, for green burials, in compliance with chapter 149A and section 306.991. +]

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 306.991, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Green burial requirements.
A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter [-that allows for-][+ must allow+] green burials[+. A green burial+] must comply with the requirements of this section.

Sec. 3.
Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 306.991, subdivision 6, is amended to read:

Subd. 6.
Burial density.
[+(a) Except as provided in paragraph (b), +]green burial plots must be a maximum of 300 burials per acre over a 100-year period.

[+(b) A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter must permit green burials at a greater density than the density specified in paragraph (a) for green burials of individuals for whom green burial is an element of the burial rites of the individual's recognized religion. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to cemeteries; requiring public cemeteries to allow individuals to be buried in accordance with their recognized religion; requiring public cemeteries to allow green burials; amending Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 306.991, subdivisions 2, 6; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 306.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[306.98] BURIAL; RITES OF RECOGNIZED RELIGION.

(a) For purposes of this section, "green burial" has the meaning given in section 149A.02, subdivision 42.

(b) A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter must permit an individual to be buried in accordance with the rites of the individual's recognized religion, including but not limited to permitting an individual to be buried by green burial, if the burial is performed in compliance with chapter 149A and, for green burials, in compliance with chapter 149A and section 306.991.

Sec. 2.
Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 306.991, subdivision 2, is amended to read:

Subd. 2.
Green burial requirements.
A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter must allow green burials. A green burial must comply with the requirements of this section.

Sec. 3.
Minnesota Statutes 2025 Supplement, section 306.991, subdivision 6, is amended to read:

Subd. 6.
Burial density.
(a) Except as provided in paragraph (b), green burial plots must be a maximum of 300 burials per acre over a 100-year period.

(b) A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter must permit green burials at a greater density than the density specified in paragraph (a) for green burials of individuals for whom green burial is an element of the burial rites of the individual's recognized religion.
additions: (a) For purposes of this section, "green burial" has the meaning given in section 149A.02, subdivision 42.

(b) A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter must permit an individual to be buried in accordance with the rites of the individual's recognized religion, including but not limited to permitting an individual to be buried by green burial, if the burial is performed in compliance with chapter 149A and, for green burials, in compliance with chapter 149A and section 306.991.

(b) A municipality, town, or other cemetery governed by this chapter must permit green burials at a greater density than the density specified in paragraph (a) for green burials of individuals for whom green burial is an element of the burial rites of the individual's recognized religion.
